title: Claude's AI is eating the jobs of its own humans. What does that signal for the rest of us?
subtitle: Anthropic's own study shows juniors fell from 27% to 9% of its new technical hires as AI took on the first draft. If nobody hires juniors, who trains the seniors you'll need in 2030?

Twice the job came back bigger: city bank branches needed 13 tellers instead of 20 but opened 43% more branches, and spreadsheets cut 400,000 clerk jobs while adding 600,000 accounting jobs. At Anthropic, juniors fell from 27% to 9% of new technical hires.
